fusions.name: Venom Lunge
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 10 damage and afflicts what it hits with [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Twin Fangs
fusions.desc: Spits 2 fangs at once, each dealing 4 damage and having a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cast-Off Coat
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you at once.

fusions.name: Venom Builds
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying an affliction, your damage rises by 15%.
